Provides for Imprisonment of up to 10 Years for
covers Individuals engaged in Polygamous Marriages Outside State or those availing benefits from Assam's Welfare Schemes.

passage_flags.claim: Supporters of a common code argue that it would reduce legal ambiguity, while critics point to the country's religious diversity.
passage_flags.problem: contradicts booklet: ambiguity reduction is attributed to the 2018 Law Commission's family-law reform (which says a UCC is neither necessary nor desirable); the diversity/unity argument is attributed to the Central Government, which favours a UCC

passage_flags.claim: The Law Commission has studied the question more than once
passage_flags.problem: not found in booklet text: only the 2018 Law Commission report is mentioned
